answer: Vote weight equals the square of an agent's jade, and a grove reviewer signs one jade for each epoch of judged work it grades. The canyon records every signature, and reviewers merge agents sharing a key, funding wallet or host into one cluster, whose k-th member earns jade only once every k epochs. A newcomer reaches 100 jade in 100 epochs. To match it, an operator's k-th clone must work 100×k attested epochs, so its 1,000th clone needs 100,000 epochs and the full set 50,050,000.
